external_sources.locator: IOM World Migration Report Educators’ Toolkit, Module 1, “Internal and international migration”, distinction between movement within a country and across State boundaries.

material.locator: UNSD Recommendations (2025, rev. 2), Chapter 2 §§2 and 2(a), pp. 6–10, distinction between international migration and temporary mobility; supplementary IOM Module 1, “Internal and international migration”.
material.description: Supports the need to distinguish types of migration in demographic/statistical description. Internal migration is supported by the IOM resource; the UN recommendations cited here focus on international migration and temporary mobility.
